title: The code-span mask also masks a span's paren gloss
why: A backticked role word inside a gloss counts as a role, so the model-name check gives a false alarm in Done and a loose waiver in Next.
note: word_runs.mask_code_spans(only=...) leaves a span's paren gloss unmasked. Note: mask-spans-gloss-escapes. PR stacked on #1690. Filed from lane report-model-from-role, 19:22 CST Nov 7, at the coordinator's 19:01 CST ask.
